The '''Baba Voza cavern''' was a cave near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Ila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was home to a tribe of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] led by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Jawa [[Lelek]].
